note: Limestone County, TX publishes no county zoning districts layer; Texas counties generally do not zone unincorporated land. The largest city, Mexia, publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (Zoning-Map-PDF) with no interactive GIS or ArcGIS service. Groesbeck's site shows no zoning map or GIS layer, only ordinances on ecode360. The Limestone CAD ArcGIS service has parcels, city limits and subdivisions but no zoning districts.
